summary: Both backend and frontend for CODES I.D. /chirpconnect tested. Backend: 7/7 pytest passing (mirrors/register, lookup, contacts add/get, WS /api/mirrors/live). Frontend web preview loads, CODES I.D. header shows red 96 circular avatar, WebSocket goes ONLINE, MIRRORS I.D. rendered (F78QUV). PTT button shows red-96 background + 'HOLD TO RECORD'; mouse-hold triggers REC state (timer/glow shown). VOICE recording itself cannot complete on headless web (browser mic 'NotFoundError' — expected per agent-to-agent note), so RELEASE TO SEND/preview modal could not be verified end-to-end on web. CODES mode picker + SEND VIA PLATFORM, Contacts BROADCAST + ADD CONTACT modal (invalid-ID lookup shows 'not found' gracefully), and Settings tab (PROFILE IMAGE + UPLOAD IMAGE, HAPTIC ENGINE ON/OFF toggle, INTENSITY LIGHT/MEDIUM/HEAVY, PULSE FREQUENCY 1X/2X/3X, iPHONE ACTION BUTTON card) all render and are interactive; settings persist across page reload (AsyncStorage). Deprecated packages detected: expo-av is imported (see chirpconnect.tsx line 29) and produces SDK-54 removal warnings on every load.

integration_issues.issue: getUserMedia returns NotFoundError in headless Chromium (no mic device). Recording start UI fires but Audio.Recording.prepareToRecordAsync throws, so preview modal never appears on web. Expected on headless — will work on device. Not a code bug.

react_native_issues.issue: expo-av is deprecated and scheduled for removal in SDK 54; app uses `Audio.Recording`/`Audio.setAudioModeAsync` from expo-av. Reference: /app/frontend/app/chirpconnect.tsx:29

React Native web deprecation warnings for `shadow*` style props (use `boxShadow`). Reference: /app/frontend/app/chirpconnect.tsx styles (pttGlowRing shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset)
React Native web deprecation warnings for `textShadow*` (use `textShadow`).
Interactive elements in chirpconnect.tsx (tabs, PTT button, mode buttons, haptic toggle/options, UPLOAD IMAGE, ADD CONTACT modal inputs) do not use `testID` — tests had to rely on text selectors.

action_items: Migrate `expo-av` → `expo-audio` (Audio.Recording API) before SDK 54 to prevent breakage. All calls are in chirpconnect.tsx (Audio.Recording, Audio.setAudioModeAsync, Audio.requestPermissionsAsync).

Add `testID` props to key elements (ptt-button, mode-voice/video/codes, tab-chirp/messages/contacts/settings, haptic-toggle, haptic-intensity-{lvl}, haptic-pulse-{n}, upload-image-btn, add-contact-btn, lookup-btn) for future testable regressions.
Replace `shadow*` and `textShadow*` style props with `boxShadow` / `textShadow` shorthand to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
For live demo: recommend running on an iOS device or a headed browser with mic permission — web headless will not complete voice recording (browser blocks getUserMedia).
critical_code_review_comments: chirpconnect.tsx line 232: `Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)` — `substr` is deprecated, use `substring` or `slice`.
chirpconnect.tsx: file is ~1600 lines; consider splitting Settings/Contacts/Codes-Picker into separate components (>700 line threshold).
backend/server.py duplicate `generate_mirrors_id()` defined twice (line ~714 and again line ~1478). Second overrides first — cleanup needed.
Frontend API_BASE has a hardcoded fallback URL (chirpconnect.tsx:44) — acceptable safety net but violates 'no hardcoded URLs' guideline; prefer failing fast.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral TEST_-prefixed mirrors ids per pid; no cleanup performed (small footprint, isolated by device_id).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live voice recording flow cannot be validated in headless browser (mic device unavailable). Verify final preview-modal + SEND CHIRP path on a real iOS device build. Backend WS /api/mirrors/live/{id} is fully functional and app connects/goes ONLINE. All requested UI additions (red 96 PTT bg, haptic controls, profile image section, glow ring, mode toggle, freq picker, contacts, settings persistence) are present and correct.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional bugs; only the expected headless-mic limitation.
